theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P (m + 1)) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ∃ ι : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P, Set.range ι = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1), ξ α = α (fun i => ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))
